inputs.name: prK
inputs.what: price rule: response to excess demand, kappa (S58 0.445, one standard error 0.240 either way; 1 is today's rule)

inputs.name: prR
inputs.what: price rule: persistence of last year's inflation, rho (S67: 0 to 0.45)

inputs.name: prA
inputs.what: price rule: weight on wage indexation, alpha (0 today; S58 0.5078)

inputs.name: prH
inputs.what: price rule: normal-years slack in the general price, h (S58 swept 0.0446)

inputs.name: prRs
inputs.what: price rule: recession slack (off as today's rule; on in S58's rule)

inputs.name: prBd
inputs.what: price rule: velocity drift, bd (S67: 0.132 from the inflation episodes)

inputs.name: sc
inputs.what: share of cash surplus spent (0.593 the published engine, 0.877 the frozen model)

inputs.name: wIdx
inputs.what: wage indexation to the programme's price level (S51 swept 0.75 to 1)

inputs.name: rho
inputs.what: income effect: earnings forgone per unconditional dollar (0.16 main; v5.4 screen's range)

inputs.name: paDem
inputs.what: PTF demand ceiling (0.49 main; 1 no ceiling)

inputs.name: drLim
inputs.what: borrowing limit for ordinary spending, $ (S61 swept 0 to 10,000; 2,500 main)

inputs.name: lfConv
inputs.what: conversion by adults outside the labour force (keep main; none)

inputs.name: lfFl
inputs.what: yearly flows in and out of the labour force (stock main; off: S61's fixed reading)

inputs.name: lfPm
inputs.what: share of the income effect taken by leaving work, pm (0.43 main; S73 swept 0 to 1)

inputs.name: rtPhi
inputs.what: pass-through of inflation to nominal assets' interest, phi (0.46 main; S59 swept 0 and 1)

inputs.name: rtNs
inputs.what: where new saving goes (nominal assets main; port: the group's asset shares)

inputs.name: rtIx
inputs.what: share of inflation real assets follow, ix (1 main; S59 half indexing)

inputs.name: rtChi
inputs.what: repricing of fixed-rate debt, chi (0 main: debt relief; 1 none)

inputs.name: bgPi
inputs.what: bargaining pass-through, pi (0 main; S60: 0.03 and 0.10 the evidence's range)

inputs.name: bgM
inputs.what: the markdown, pay over what workers add (1/1.21 main; 1/1.53 manufacturing; 1 none)

inputs.name: poCost
inputs.what: PTF running cost (full main; sector: observed costs; hub: the Hub's costs as stated)

inputs.name: poRes
inputs.what: PTF reserve (0.017 main; 0 none)

inputs.name: poW
inputs.what: half-width of the density tests' band (0.20 main; S62 swept 0.10 and 0.40)

inputs.name: poTest
inputs.what: what the density tests read (sales main; members; capacity)

inputs.name: poHire
inputs.what: PTF hiring limit, points a year (none main; 0.05 and 0.02 stress readings)

inputs.name: poBonus
inputs.what: who gets the conversion bonus (PTF workers main; members)

inputs.name: poPay
inputs.what: who pays the PTF cut's running cost (the Source main; price: PTF prices rise)

inputs.name: crInc
inputs.what: creditor side: who bears the inflated debt (pass main; hold; hedge)

inputs.name: crOut
inputs.what: creditor side: the government's and foreigners' parts left outside (1 main; 0 every dollar on a model household)

inputs.name: crPop
inputs.what: creditor side: the model's families as the whole household sector (0 main; 1)

inputs.name: wtCut
inputs.what: where the weighted tail starts (main: the rule's 97.5th percentile; p99; p90)

inputs.name: wtA
inputs.what: the tail exponent, shift from the cut's own value (one standard error either way: 1.354 to 1.626 at the main cut)

inputs.name: wtM
inputs.what: tail households per type (3 main; S59 swept 6)
